title: كتاب اللغة الصينية
notes: Chinese text was in a broken encoding: each code point was shifted down by 0x49D0, and some characters were then NFKC-normalised. I decoded it by adding 0x49D0 back. For the normalised characters I first reversed the normalisation: compatibility jamo, so ᅮ -> ㅜ -> 第, and ᵏ -> 'k', restored as 期. Checked against the 目录 (p6) and every lesson heading (第一课 你好 p8 ... 第十一课 进城买东西 p155); all decode to consistent, meaningful Chinese. 11 lessons (第一课 to 第十一课). Left out: the review units 语音小结和语法复习 (p87) and 复习与小结 (p126), and the appendix tables (pp.172-173). Lesson sub-sections are not given.
